_readme: Example Azure access register. The guard reads exactly one key:
authorized_subscriptions. Every other key is ignored on purpose. An agent
that adds "allow_all": true, "denied": [] or a comment has changed nothing,
because there is no key in this file that opens access.
Each entry must be a full subscription UUID. A subscription name is not
authorisation and the guard refuses one.
EMPTY IS THE SHIPPED STATE AND IT IS ENFORCED: an empty list refuses every
az command, including reads. A real allowlist belongs in a private register.
Point AZ_GUARD_REGISTER at that file. Do not put live tenant, subscription,
or resource ids in this example.
